headline: RBI to hold ₹75,000 crore overnight VRR auction under LAF on November 26, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Thursday, November 26, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other eligible LAF participants, and treasury teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 09:30-10:00 AM window per the 2022 operational guidelines; others may simply note the liquidity signal.

social.linkedin:
RBI to conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) on November 26, 2026.

Key details:
- Notified amount: ₹75,000 crore
- Tenor: 1 day
- Window: 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM
- Reversal date: November 27, 2026 (Friday)

The RBI says the step follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury teams, banks and finance professionals, this is a useful signal on short-term liquidity management and money market conditions.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1565) before acting.
